title: The Home agent's build card says what DCLab will build
request: The owner's goal: every R&D agent behind the chat, the person approving what they can see.
spec: the last open item of the agents plan
plan: read the draft through the person's channel before the build's card
add what gets built in the person's words

decisions.decision: The card reads the draft as it is now and says so
decisions.why: home_build builds the draft's current understanding; a draft that cannot be read keeps the plain card rather than blocking the build

findings.defect: the Home agent's build card did not say what gets built
findings.scenario: home_build's card: 'This may build the project and run its five stages; the last stage reads the holdout once'
findings.cause: the card came from the guard's fixed text
findings.fix: the card adds the problem, the outcome, the prediction moment, the unit, what to leave out, the costs, the budget and the table, from the draft (each at most 400 characters)
findings.test: dclab-code server test (the card names the outcome, the moment, the column to leave out and the table)

outcome: Both ways a chat builds a project, the understanding team and the Home agent, now show the person what gets built before they approve.
lessons: When one path to a decision gains a clearer card, check every other path to the same decision.
risks: the Home build's card is not keyed: a draft changed after the card is built as it is then
